label: TARGET REPAIR ONLY - representation-independent by construction. BabySlakh tracks remain consumed; nothing here is promotable.
execution_environment: Anthropic cloud container (HOST-class). BabySlakh 16 kHz, md5 verified against the publisher's checksum.

construction.episode_source: the isolated-note episodes already generated by J3I, unchanged

reused_without_change.timing_envelope: RMS over a 512-sample (32 ms) rectangular window on the analysis hop grid, causal
reused_without_change.absolute_silence_criterion: silence_mask at SILENCE_FLOOR_DBFS = -60.0 dBFS on the existing dsp_register_features RMS

full_attack_curve_not_a_scalar.definition: a(tau) = envelope(note_on + tau) / local_peak, clipped to [0, 1], tau in hops
full_attack_curve_not_a_scalar.local_peak: maximum of the timing envelope inside [note_on, note_off + 0.2 s] - the J3I definition, unchanged

TRUNCATION_RULE_DECLARED_BEFORE_AGGREGAT.rule: a(tau) is taken for tau = 0..K_MAX. It is made monotone non-decreasing by a running maximum (cumulative max), so that vibrato or tremolo dips during the rise are not modelled as de-activation. The episode also contributes only up to its own note-off, and episodes shorter than K_MAX hold their last observed value.
TRUNCATION_RULE_DECLARED_BEFORE_AGGREGAT.why_K_MAX_32: 1.024 s, four times the lag-8 movement window and four times the slowest measured attack_50 (synth_lead_pad, 8 hops). Declared, not tuned.

full_attack_curve_not_a_scalar.kernel_from_episodes: k_raw(tau) = MEDIAN over contributing episodes of the monotone a(tau). k(tau) = k_raw(tau) / k_raw(K_MAX), so the kernel reaches exactly 1.0 at K_MAX and the SHAPE of the rise is preserved. k(tau) = 1.0 for tau > K_MAX. This implements the brief's 'after the kernel reaches 1.0, hold at 1.0'.

CROSS_FITTING_MANDATORY.scheme: grouped leave-one-track-out. When evaluating any stem of track T, that stem's family kernel is built ONLY from episodes belonging to tracks other than T. The evaluated track never contributes waveform information to its own target.
CROSS_FITTING_MANDATORY.reported: the number of source episodes and source tracks contributing to every held-out family kernel

FALLBACK_HIERARCHY_DECLARED_BEFORE_ANY_C.why_20: the same low-power flag already used in J3I. Not a new threshold.

attack_class_groups_defined_A_PRIORI_BY_.why_a_priori: grouping by measured attack time would let all-track measurements leak into a held-out track's group assignment. Organological grouping uses no measurement at all.
attack_class_groups_defined_A_PRIORI_BY_.disclosure: J3I measured brass and strings at 1-hop attack_50, so placing them in BLOWN_BOWED is an a-priori choice that its own measurement does not support. Both families are small (17 and 12 episodes) and neither is among the seven the brief asks to report. Recorded so the choice is visible.

chromatic_percussion_red_flag.rule: J3I found no attack/gate mismatch for this family, so a large improvement would indicate a target-construction problem, not a win
